Liam (Partnerships): Heads-up: CloudWorks wants a compact 'deploy & verify' pack for our refkit Terraform modules so they can onboard to the marketplace next month. Can we outline a thin validation flow?
Zoe (Cloud Eng): Proposal: one-region demo (us-east-2), single private VPC, single nodepool with g5.2x, and a manifest template. Keep infra ~1 hour to deploy.
Harpreet (Solutions): Important for SIs: include a `credentials.example.env` showing how to inject marketplace keys and KMS ARN. Also a minimal data-flow svg.
Tom (DevEx): I'll create a `quick-verify.sh` that runs terraform apply, waits for /health, then posts a sample generate and verifies a streaming header. Exit codes: 0 = pass, 2 = infra error, 3 = runtime error.
Liam (Partnerships): Nice. Compatibility matrix needed: runtime versions, recommended quantization (fp16 vs int8), and supported OS/arch. Keep that in COMPAT.md.
Zoe (Cloud Eng): We'll add a terraform var `enable_prefetch` and helm value override for `kv_cache_size`. Also pin provider to >=4.51.
Harpreet (Solutions): Manifest template should include `supported_instances`, `min_kms_level`, `model_variants` array with inline notes. I'll prepare `examples/cloudworks.example.json`.
CI-Bot: PR created: partners/cloudworks-packaging — smoke job queued.
Tom (DevEx): Metrics: smoke should emit trace_id, p50_latency_ms, tokens_generated to our staging telemetry endpoint. I'll document mapping in metrics.md.
Liam (Partnerships): Timeline: checklist + manifest template by Fri, verify.sh + COMPAT.md by Mon, run a preview with CloudWorks next Wed.
Zoe (Cloud Eng): If anyone needs sandbox access, DM me; I'll provision a project.
Harpreet (Solutions): I'll draft a 1-page SI runbook with rollback steps (scale to 0, switch to fallback-model).
Liam (Partnerships): Great — short sync Mon 09:00 UTC to confirm readiness. Thanks all.
_meta: slack thread: compact packaging/validation flow for cloud partner marketplace onboarding
